description: Find messages in `searchFolder` that belong to the same conversation threads as messages already in `sourceFolder`. Useful for catching replies that arrived after a thread was sorted. Works on any IMAP server (uses RFC 3501 HEADER search on In-Reply-To and References). Set `includeBody=true` to also return the parsed body for each found thread message in one round-trip — avoids the N+1 cost of calling imap_get_email per thread member.

accountId.description: Account ID (from imap_list_accounts). Optional if accountName is given or only one account is configured.

accountName.description: Account name instead of accountId. Optional if accountId is given or only one account is configured.

bodyFormat.description: How to render the body when `includeBody` is true. Mirrors `imap_get_email` — "markdown" (default) returns clean Markdown; "text" returns plain text; "html" returns raw HTML; "auto" prefers substantive text/plain, else Markdown.

bodyMaxLength.description: Per-message cap (in characters) for each rendered body field when `includeBody` is true. Defaults to 10000 to match `imap_get_email`.

includeBody.description: If true, also fetch the parsed message body for each found thread message in the same round-trip and return it alongside headers (avoids the N+1 cost of calling imap_get_email per thread member). Body is rendered per `bodyFormat` and capped at `bodyMaxLength` characters per field.

searchFolder.description: Folder to search for related thread messages (default: INBOX)

searchReferences.description: Also search the References header for multi-level threads (default: true)

sourceFolder.description: Folder containing the already-sorted thread messages (e.g. "Review.Articles")

name: imap_find_thread_messages
